Score items with the game's built-in aggregate instead of the per-slot parameter weights. Weights explicitly requested from the AI still win.
Compare items stat by stat in a per-slot priority order instead of weighted scoring: the top stat decides, ties fall through to the next one. Reorder the stats in each slot's filter window.

Parameter weights: balanced choice - every weighted stat counts, one huge stat cannot outweigh the rest, and a swap is only suggested when the item is clearly better. Stat priority: strict order - the top stat decides, lower ones only break ties; reorder and link stats in the slot filter. Game Effectiveness: the game's single built-in quality score - no setup, but crude.
Tint of the per-slot equip buttons, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. #FFFFFF keeps the original look. Applied when the inventory is reopened.
